reviewer: Codex agent, source-grounded manual adjudication; not independent human review

criteria.correct: Answerable: a delivered Ollama answer resolves the core question with supported claims. Unanswerable: no_evidence with no invented answer. Fallback does not pass even if its excerpts contain the answer.
criteria.complete: In addition to core correctness, answer prose explicitly covers all facts in expected_answer. Citation text alone does not fill omissions.
criteria.all_claims_supported: Every delivered claim is supported by its cited text. Fallback excerpts may be supported while correct=false. Null for refusals with no claims.

limitations: AI-authored development questions from 3 AI-assisted documents; no held-out or real-user set.
Completeness is stricter than the literal question for OPS01, OPS05, OPS07 and OPS09; these are omissions, not false factual claims.
Raw automatic summary.json semantic_accuracy remains null; use this file and semantic_review.json for agent adjudication.
